title: Baked Snapper with Egyptian Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic fish dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe uses snapper fillets and a blend of Egyptian spices to create a mouthwatering meal.

ingredients.name: Tagine Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Season the snapper fillets with salt and black pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together the tagine spice blend and a pinch of salt.
Brush the snapper fillets with olive oil and sprinkle with the tagine spice blend mixture.
Place the snapper fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and garnished with parsley.
